findings.claim: EnumTemplate.cs uses the inverted guard `#if NETSTANDARD2_0 || NETFRAMEWORK`, while every other template uses `#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK`. Any enum used as a member of a `[MessagePackObject]` in a net8.0 project yields an enum formatter without the attribute. The requirement says all generated code must be decorated, so it is not met for enum formatters on modern TFMs.
